related.title: 科學級 CCD 成像系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「光子到電子：量子效率與像素結構」與「光子轉移法：增益、讀出雜訊與全井容量」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；科學級 CCD 成像系統的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Photons to electrons: quantum efficiency and pixel structure" and "Photon-transfer method: gain, read noise and full-well capacity" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Scientific CCD imaging systems must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦背照式 sCMOS 的像素物理、讀出雜訊、快門時序、EMVA 1288 校正與系統訊噪比預算；科學級 CCD 成像系統則以背照式量子效率、電荷轉移效率、輸出放大器讀出雜訊、深冷暗電流與光子轉移增益校正為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on pixel physics, read noise, shutter timing, EMVA 1288 calibration and system SNR budgets for back-illuminated sCMOS; Scientific CCD imaging systems centres on back-illuminated QE, charge-transfer efficiency, output-amplifier read noise, deep-cooled dark current and photon-transfer gain calibration, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「背照式像素與釘扎光電二極體」與「背照式矽吸收層」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到科學級 CCD 成像系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「光子轉移曲線與 Fe-55 增益校正」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Back-illuminated pixel and pinned photodiode” and “Back-illuminated silicon absorber”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Scientific CCD imaging systems, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Photon transfer curve and Fe-55 gain calibration", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 科學級 CMOS 成像系統
history.text: CMOS 主動像素感測器由 NASA 噴射推進實驗室的 Eric Fossum 團隊在 1990 年代初發展，目標是取代功耗高、需要專用製程的 CCD；2009 年 Andor、Fairchild Imaging 與 PCO 共同發表第一代科學級 CMOS，以行級平行 ADC 與相關雙取樣達到約 1 e⁻ 的讀出雜訊與每秒 100 幀的全幅速度；2016 年前後背照式 sCMOS 把峰值量子效率推到 95%，2021 年量子型 CMOS（qCMOS）更把讀出雜訊降到 0.3 e⁻ 以下，使單一曝光能分辨光子數。本課只整理公開的物理與量測方法，不涉及任何廠商的製程細節。
history.textEn: CMOS active-pixel sensors were developed by Eric Fossum's group at NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory in the early 1990s to replace power-hungry CCDs that needed a dedicated process; in 2009 Andor, Fairchild Imaging and PCO jointly introduced the first scientific CMOS, whose parallel column ADCs and correlated double sampling reached about 1 electron of read noise at 100 full frames per second; around 2016 back-illuminated sCMOS pushed peak quantum efficiency to 95 percent, and in 2021 quantitative CMOS (qCMOS) brought read noise below 0.3 electron, allowing photon numbers to be resolved in a single exposure. This course collects only public physics and measurement methods, not any vendor's process details.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「光子到電子：量子效率與像素結構」到「相機驗收、觸發時序與資料鏈路交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Photons to electrons: quantum efficiency and pixel structure" through "Camera acceptance, trigger timing and data-link handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
